mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies and a temperature of 51 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park.

City officials announced that road maintenance for crack filling begins September 28. Contractors will be working on several streets including South Nine Mound Road and Commerce Parkway, so expect potential lane closures and use caution in those areas.

Today you can head over to Hop Haus Trivia for some local fun. Looking into tomorrow, there is a full lineup including yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.

On September 5, police responded to a strange situation where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields throughout several city streets, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, though please be aware the location is currently closed for a remodel.
